name: Many small donations from geographically diverse donors to a single organiser
description: Large numbers of low-value contributions from many countries into one recipient account that then withdraws promptly.
fp: Viral humanitarian appeals and memorial funds show similar patterns.

sources.text: FATF, Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Guidance (2019)
